game_title: Function Test Arena – Lantern Square Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Lantern Square, a lantern-lit square: the snow ranger must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing ice wolves.
theme: Snowy Hold – Lantern Square: a lantern-lit square
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Square, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing ice wolves. Each round, ice wolves strike the sleigh, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from ice wolves in Lantern Square: keep the tests_passed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: tests_passed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Lantern Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while tests_passed > 0.
